'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[Dedebit airstrike]]
***At least 56 people are killed by an [[airstrike]] on an [[IDP camp]] in [[Dedebit (town)|Dedebit]], [[Tigray Region]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/ethiopia-at-least-56-killed-in-tigray-air-strike-on-camp-for-internally-displaced-aid-workers-say-12511519 (Sky News)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**[[2022 Zamfara massacres]]
***At least 200 people were killed by a [[bandit]] group from January 4 to 6 in [[Zamfara State]] in [[North West (Nigeria)|northwestern]] [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/9/about-200-dead-in-bandit-attacks-in-northwest-nigeria-residents (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Murree snowstorm]]
**At least 21 people are killed by a [[snowstorm]] on a highway in [[Murree]], [[Rawalpindi District]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59920215 (BBC News)]
*[[Capitólio rock collapse]]
**At least seven people are killed and 32 others injured when a rock face collapses onto boats at Furnas Lake in [[Capitólio]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/wall-of-rock-falls-on-boaters-in-brazilian-lake-2-die/2022/01/08/43510cb0-70be-11ec-b1e2-0539da8f4451_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*A [[traffic collision]] between two buses in [[South Sinai Governorate]], [[Egypt]], kills 16 people and injures 18 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/sixteen-dead-road-accident-egypts-south-sinai-health-ministry-2022-01-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Volcán Wolf]], the tallest [[mountain]] and [[volcano]] in the [[Galápagos Islands]], erupts. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/07/galapagos-islands-volcano-erupts-lava-ash (''The Guardian'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****A [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] scientist reportedly detects a variant of the SARS-CoV-2 called "Deltacron", which combines genomes found in the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant]] and genetic signatures found in the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/01/08/cyprus-reportedly-discovers-a-covid-variant-that-combines-omicron-and-delta.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] reintroduces [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mandatory face mask wearing]] in outdoor and indoor public spaces; reduces the operating hours and capacity of bars, restaurants, cinemas, gyms, and sporting events; and also reduces the [[quarantine]] period, amidst concern that the next wave of COVID-19 could overwhelm the health system. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-business-health-europe-pandemics-87a0b3d02ae4ec636625afcf388abf55 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Victoria, Crown Princess of Sweden]] tests positive for COVID-19 for a second time. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2022-01-08/swedish-crown-princess-victoria-tests-positive-for-covid-19  (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The number of confirmed [[COVID-19]] cases in [[Australia]] surpasses 100,000 for the first time since the beginning of the pandemic, with [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] reporting a record 51,356 new cases in the past 24 hours after including [[rapid antigen test]]s as part of the total number of cases. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/world/459223/covid-19-in-australia-more-than-100k-new-cases-reported-in-one-day (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
***[[Mexico]] reports a record 30,671 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4.1 million. The country also surpasses 300,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-01-09/mexico-breaks-daily-covid-record-with-over-30-000-new-cases (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***The [[Philippines]] reports a record 26,458 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,936,875. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/01/08/22/philippines-logs-all-time-high-26458-covid-19-cases (ABS-CBN News)]
